svg.aria-label: Top: greedy routes after training for seed 0. Bottom: training returns with persistent ε=0.1 exploration. Each algorithm uses 8 seeds and 500 episodes. Shading is the interquartile range; lower-right points average each seed’s last 100 episodes. Routes and training curves evaluate different policies.
